subject.title: Replacement for accidentally closed #3102: ClawScan backend error persists despite clean VirusTotal

question: Should an authorized operator requeue the full ClawScan after inspecting these exact production jobs, or hold the artifact until the worker failure is root-caused?
rationale: Only production diagnostics can establish whether requeueing is safe and sufficient, while manually deriving a final verdict from clean VirusTotal telemetry would violate the documented layered-scanner boundary.

options.title: Inspect and requeue full scan
options.body: Validate the immutable artifact and failed job states, then requeue the complete ClawScan with writeback enabled and confirm the resulting registry verdict.

options.title: Hold for worker root cause
options.body: Keep the artifact’s security status unresolved until the repeated VirusTotal-state failure is diagnosed and repaired before another scan attempt.

recommendation.title: Inspect and requeue full scan
recommendation.body: Validate the immutable artifact and failed job states, then requeue the complete ClawScan with writeback enabled and confirm the resulting registry verdict.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history most directly connects this contributor to the original VirusTotal-backed scanner integration.
